// Planted public API of the ./hashurl entry point, the version before the change.

/** Removed by the change. */
export function plantedRemoved(): number {
	return 1;
}

/** Renamed by the change. */
export function plantedRenamedOld(): number {
	return 2;
}

/** Gains a required parameter in the change. */
export function plantedSignature(a: number): number {
	return a;
}

/** Kept as a deprecated alias in the change. */
export function plantedDeprecated(a: number): number {
	return a;
}

/** An interface that loses a member and keeps one. */
export interface PlantedShape {
	kept: string;
	dropped: number;
}

/** A class that loses a method and keeps one. */
export class PlantedClass {
	kept(): number {
		return 1;
	}
	dropped(): number {
		return 2;
	}
}
